SOURCE_RECEIPT.capture: GET current-deal JSON with apikey; one request per run.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.local_evidence: One current deal item; current price only when no list price is supplied.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.variant_policy: Item variants are kept distinct by item id/query.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.limitations: One deal per day; current price only; no historical or list price guarantee.

PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.regular_price_role: List/MSRP only when supplied; otherwise null.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.rejections: Sold-out deal is not emitted as a purchasable offer.

RIGHTS_RECEIPT.note: User-supplied API key; purpose and redistribution rights remain to be reviewed.
